privacy.title: Privacy and consent
privacy.intro: Two separate choices, each recorded with the exact words you saw. Answering is needed for your answers to count. Sale is optional and off unless you turn it on.
privacy.draft: Draft. The consent wording has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer and may change.
privacy.sale: Including your answers in data that is sold
privacy.saleState: {state, select, on {On} gpc {Off: Global Privacy Control} other {Off}}
privacy.withdrawNote: Withdrawing stops new answers from counting until you agree again. Your answers so far stay; delete them one by one, or delete your account below to remove them all.
privacy.offNote: Turning it off removes you from every sale from now on.
privacy.onNote: Turning it on agrees to this text:
privacy.gpc: Your browser is sending a Global Privacy Control signal, so sale is off and stays off.
privacy.closed: Data sales aren't offered where you are, so nothing about you is sold.
privacy.nothingSold: Nothing is sold yet. Sale will only ever happen where the law allows it, after legal review.
privacy.historyLine: {date}: {choice, select, answering {Answering} other {Sale}}, {granted, select, yes {agreed} other {off}} · version {version} · {surface}

about.title: About you (optional)
about.intro: None of this is needed for anything. It is used only in totals, where small groups are hidden, and you can clear any of it at any time.
about.countryNote: Two-letter code, like US or MX.
about.childrenNote: Only son, daughter or child and an age range. Never a name, a birth date or an account: nobody under 18 can have one.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Everything the site holds about your account: your votes and every change to them, questions you asked, reports you filed, your consent choices and anything you told us about yourself. Your phone number isn't included because it is never stored.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.body: Your current votes are withdrawn from every result straight away{paid, select, yes { and your membership is cancelled} other {}}. Your consent records and anything you told us about yourself are deleted. The dated record of past votes stays in the historical results, with nothing that connects it to you. This can't be undone. <link>More in the privacy policy</link>.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.welcome: Add a passkey so next time you sign in with Face ID, your fingerprint or your computer's PIN instead of a texted code. Or <link>skip for now</link>.
security.saved: {what, select, username {Username changed.} pin {PIN saved.} password {Password saved.} totpOff {Authenticator app turned off.} other {Saved.}}
security.passkeysNote: The fastest and safest way to sign in. Your device checks your face, fingerprint or PIN itself; nothing biometric is ever sent to us.
security.totpOn: On. Signing in with a texted code or a password also asks for a code from your app. {n, plural, one {# recovery code} other {# recovery codes}} left.
security.totpSetup: In your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or the iPhone Passwords app), add an account with this setup key, or open the link on the phone that has the app.
security.totpOff: A second step after a texted code or password: a six-digit code from an app on your phone. Free, and works offline.
security.pinNote: Asked for before removing a passkey, turning off the authenticator app, changing your password or deleting your account. 4 to 8 digits; stored only as a one-way hash.
security.usernameNote: Letters, numbers and underscores. You can change it once a day.
security.passwordNote: Optional. {has, select, yes {You can sign in with your username and password.} other {Without one, you sign in with a passkey or a texted code.}}
security.idCheckOn: Confirm your identity with a face scan and a photo ID for the verified tier.
security.idCheckOff: A face scan with a photo ID, for the verified tier, isn't available yet.
